scope: Current producer application directions only, P01-P08; independent source supplement, no reclassification or efficacy assessment.
capture_method: Official producer/brand-market pages and an identified DE brand-distributor article. Page text or explicitly labelled inspected search excerpt. Observations are paraphrases; no raw page copy retained.
boundary: A source amendment for subsequent owner handling. No sealed replay history, formula selection, property assessment, catalog or production state was changed.

sections: FAQ: Pre-Shampoo / nach dem Shampoonieren / über Nacht
observations: Producer places No.3PLUS before shampoo, on wet hair in the shower.
Apply generously across roots through tips; retain for 3 minutes, then rinse.
Follow with OLAPLEX shampoo and conditioner; suggested frequency is once per 1–3 hair washes.
FAQ says overnight application is unnecessary and recommends the pre-shampoo sequence.
limitations: Directions identify No.3PLUS; 100 ml was not exposed in the inspected page text.
No quantified dose or explicit physical texture was found in the inspected directions.
No actual bottle label inspected.

sources.publisher: K18 German brand shop / Kevin Murphy GmbH
observations: Page identifies the 50 ml leave-in mask.
Wash with K18 Peptide Prep Detox Shampoo, omit conditioner at this stage, and towel-dry thoroughly.
Begin with one pump; increase if needed according to hair length, thickness and condition. Distribute evenly in sections across roots through tips.
Wait 4 minutes; do not rinse the mask at this step. Optional K18 Damage Shield Conditioner follows the mask and is then rinsed; style afterward.
German cadence: first four consecutive washes, then every fourth wash.
For regular use of rich oils, silicones or film-forming stylers, the page specifically recommends prior Detox Shampoo.
limitations: No physical pack inspected. Physical texture is not explicitly specified in these DE directions.
The DE cadence and root-to-tip distribution wording are retained separately from international directions.

observations: 50 ml product page explicitly describes a cream format and leave-in treatment mask.
Shampoo without conditioner and thoroughly towel-dry; apply 1–3 pumps according to length and density, moving from ends toward roots.
Wait a full 4 minutes before combing, styling or adding products; do not rinse the mask.
Conditioner is permitted after the four-minute wait, but not before mask application.
Use for 4–6 consecutive shampoos; how-to section names 4–6 washes after salon service, then as needed.
Heavy product users are told to clarify beforehand; mineral or metal buildup is a separate stated reason for demineralizing.
limitations: Cross-market complement only; not a replacement for DE directions or proof of DE-pack equality.
International dose, application direction and cadence differ in specificity from C03-P02-1.

sections: How do I use K18 conditioner with the mask?
observations: The official support answer permits K18 conditioner four minutes after application of the leave-in molecular repair mask.
limitations: This brief FAQ supplies timing, not a complete washing or rinsing procedure.
The displayed update age is relative (8 months), not an exact publication date.
International supplement; does not independently establish German-pack directions.

sections: How often should I use it?
observations: FAQ generally suggests once or twice weekly, adjusted to repair needs; it allows more frequent initial use for very damaged or overprocessed hair and describes weekly maintenance.
For damaged hair, apply first to the most compromised sections, such as mid-lengths and ends, then work toward healthier sections.
Conditioner afterward is optional; for particularly dry hair, the article suggests a light leave-in conditioner or styling product.
limitations: Article is dated 2024-12-08 and was accessed on the checked date; continued availability does not establish a newly issued protocol.
This weekly cadence is recorded as a separate producer variant, without normalizing it to DE every-fourth-wash or US 4–6-wash directions.
This article alone does not specify the conditioner waiting interval; C03-P02-3 does.

observations: Starter-kit instructions specify an ampoule emptied into its accompanying epres spray bottle, filled with tap, distilled or mineral water, then fitted with the sprayer and shaken.
Spray dry, unwashed hair until fully saturated; retain at least 10 minutes, then shampoo and condition as usual.
Use 1–2 times weekly, with the FAQ tying frequency to damage severity.
FAQ also permits leaving the treatment in without immediately washing; subsequent normal shampoo and conditioner remain part of the stated routine.
Use the prepared mixture within two months.
limitations: The inspected current starter-kit page does not quantify bottle capacity or water volume; no numerical dilution ratio inferred.
15 ml ampoule identity is complemented separately by C03-P03-3.
No actual starter-bottle label inspected.

observations: Empty one concentrate vial into the epres spray bottle, fill with water, attach sprayer and shake; tap, distilled or bottled water are allowed.
Spray enough onto dry, unwashed hair to saturate it fully; leave at least 10 minutes before cleansing and styling.
Overnight use is explicitly allowed; the FAQ separately permits use without immediate washout.
Producer recommends 1–2 weekly applications and using a mixed bottle within two months.
FAQ advises conditioner after use and names Healthy Hair Shampoo and Healthy Hair Conditioner.
limitations: Cross-market complement; DE page names ordinary shampoo and conditioner instead of requiring these named US partners.
No numerical water volume or dilution ratio stated in the inspected instructions.
No numerical maximum contact time inferred from the overnight option.

sources.publisher: Kevin Murphy Germany / epres German brand distributor
observations: Distributor article identifies a retail kit containing the spray bottle and two 15 ml ampoules, and a refill presentation with two 15 ml ampoules.
Instructions use the contents of one ampoule in the epres bottle, topped up with water and shaken; saturate hair, retain at least 10 minutes, then wash and style. Suggested use is 1–2 times weekly.
limitations: Article dated 2023-09-20; accessed now as pack/presentation context, not a newly issued product label.
Does not specify bottle capacity or exact added-water volume.
This article discusses salon services elsewhere; those statements are not imported into the home-treatment protocol.

observations: Producer directions identify Bond Repair Plus Keratin-Festigendes Pre-Shampoo and place it before washing.
Apply a generous amount to damp hair across the scalp through the ends.
Retain for five minutes, then rinse thoroughly with clear water until residues are removed.
Continue with Bond Repair Plus shampoo, conditioner and leave-in serum.
The FAQ explicitly includes scalp, lengths and ends as application areas.
limitations: Direct page open initially returned a page listing but follow-up page retrieval failed; producer directions were inspected in the search-engine excerpt, excluding customer reviews.
The inspected excerpt does not establish the 200 ml pack size, physical texture, dose volume or cadence.
Generic FAQ discussion of other pre-shampoos lasting 5–20 minutes is not treated as this product's instruction.

observations: Producer positions Acidic Bonding Concentrate Intensive Treatment as a pretreatment before the line's shampoo and conditioner.
Apply to damp hair; retain for 5–10 minutes and rinse.
Continue with Redken Acidic Bonding Concentrate Shampoo and Conditioner.
limitations: Protocol source only; no formula version selected or replaced.
190 ml pack size is not exposed in inspected page text.
No specific hair region, distribution method, quantity, texture or cadence is given in the inspected instructions.

observations: Official UK page identifies the 50 ml Sealing Serum.
Before bed, spread a small amount between hands and distribute evenly through damp or dry hair, beginning at the ends and moving upward.
Leave in overnight; rinsing is not required. Suggested use is 1–2 times weekly.
The range routine says cleanse and condition first, then apply the Bond Protein Repair oil or serum.
limitations: UK label-direction complement only. No official DE directions were located by the bounded searches; DE/EU pack equality is unresolved.
Serum is the explicit producer format label; no viscosity, spray format or dose in ml inferred.
Overnight is the stated use pattern, not a numeric minimum or maximum contact-time measurement.

observations: The 150 ml pre-shampoo treatment is explicitly described as a gel-cream.
Apply to dry hair across roots through tips before shampooing.
Retain 5–10 minutes, rinse, then use Botanical Repair Strengthening Shampoo and Conditioner.
For mild-to-moderate damage, use weekly; for moderate-to-severe damage, use each wash day.
limitations: Producer damage bands overlap at moderate; no exclusive cutoff or independent damage assessment is inferred.
No quantified amount or distinct sectioning/distribution technique given.
No actual pack label inspected.

observations: Page offers 45 ml and 250 ml variants and describes the product as a pretreatment concentrate.
Before shampoo, apply generously to damp lengths and massage in.
Wait five minutes without rinsing; apply Bain Première shampoo directly over the treatment.
Rinse after the shampoo step, then use a Première conditioner or hair mask.
limitations: Page title mentions travel format while its size selector also exposes 250 ml; the title alone is not used as pack proof.
Five minutes is the wait before layering shampoo, not total treatment contact time or a standalone rinse point.
No numerical dose, physical texture or cadence established in inspected instructions.
No actual 250 ml pack label inspected.
